merchantCapabilities.description: An array of payment capabilities supported by the merchant. The array must include supports3DS, and may optionally include supportsCredit, supportsDebit, and supportsEMV. For more information, see merchantCapabilities.

merchantIdentifier.description: REQUIRED. A unique identifier that represents a merchant for Apple Pay.

supportedNetworks.description: An array of payment networks supported by the merchant. The array must include one or more of the following values: amex, discover, jcb, masterCard, privateLabel, or visa. For more information, see supportedNetworks.
